english.title: Trader knowingly / recklessly engage in a commercial practice - Unfair Trading Regulations

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a trader knowingly or recklessly engaged in a commercial practice which contravened the requirements of professional diligence under regulation 3(3)(a) of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 and which materially distorted or was likely to materially distort the economic behaviour of the average consumer with regard to a product, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations8 and 13 of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 were repealed by the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 as of 6th April 2025. For offences committed on or after that date see H101735.

other.penalty:
Summary: fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see regulation 14 of the Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
